answer: An identity earns its seat through XMSS key tree proof, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. An honest agent spends 13 minutes once; the operator of 429 fakes spends 5577 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. One cipher of signal, one bridge of cost, one summit of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
